limitations: No provider or network integration is implemented.
No exchange or market-session calendar is implemented.
Gap reporting assumes a constant supplied resolution and does not account for sessions or holidays.
OHLCV numeric transport uses binary float; Decimal adoption is deferred pending an approved exact JSON-number serialization contract.
Run immutability is logical development behavior, not physical filesystem immutability.
No frozen or separately protected Methodology Kernel artifact exists yet.
Naive timestamps are interpreted as UTC and explicitly marked by provenance.
The first pre-hardening development test run briefly used Windows TEMP; tests were corrected to use Runtime_WORKSPACE/tests.
